summary: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release dated August 21, 2026, announcing engagement of Tetra Tech Canada Inc. to complete a Pre-Feasibility Study for its wholly-owned Morrison Copper-Gold Project, with an updated resource estimate expected in about a month and PFS completion in Q1 2027. The release also disclosed stock option exercises since May 1, 2026, yielding approximately $2.07 million at mostly $3.00 per share, used to repay a director loan and payables. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation event; watch for PFS results and resource estimate announcement.
